newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes up 6.2 against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes up 6.2 against dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso rebounded 6.2 pesos against the dollar to close at 1,016.7 in Wednesday's session, interbank dealers said.
The peso fell back to 1,025 by last Friday's close, but has rallied steadily in Tuesday and Wednesday's sessions.
"The dollar was artificially high at the start of the week and what we're seeing is a process of correction," one interbank trader said.
The peso sank last week as the public sector snapped up dollars to service foreign debt, while banks moved to cover forward dollar positions and tried to make a quick profit from speculating.

This week, however, dollar payments from December's government power plant privatization program have continued to flow into the currency markets coupled with earnings from traditional export sectors.
Dealers said volume was average, with 377 trades worth a total $172 million. The peso hit an intraday high of 1,016.3 after opening at an intraday low of 1,022.
